preamble: You are working in the repository at {WORKSPACE}. It is a git repository with a Quest tracker. Do the task below. When you finish, write your complete final reply to the user - exactly what you would say in chat, including any diagrams - to {OUTPUTS}/answer.md. If the task asks you to change files, change them in {WORKSPACE}.

evals.name: architecture-overview-intermediate
evals.prompt: I'm the new product owner for this shop and I need to understand how it's put together. Can you give me an overview of the system with a diagram I could paste into our docs?
evals.expected_output: A container-level diagram of the real parts (web app, orders API, fulfilment worker, Postgres, Stripe, ShipEngine) with a plain-English explanation; no invented components.
assertions: Every diagram parses under mermaid 11.17.2
Every diagram has accTitle and accDescr
Every diagram stays within the intermediate node cap (12)
A plain-English explanation of at least 30 words accompanies the diagram
Every node is a component that exists in the repository
All six real components are drawn (web, orders API, worker, Postgres, Stripe, ShipEngine)
No invented components (cache, queue, gateway, ...)

evals.name: architecture-for-cfo-beginner

assertions: Every diagram parses under mermaid 11.17.2
Every diagram has accTitle and accDescr
Every diagram stays within the beginner node cap (7)
A plain-English explanation of at least 30 words accompanies the diagram
Every node is a component that exists in the repository
Stripe and ShipEngine are both drawn
No invented components (cache, queue, gateway, ...)

assertions: Every diagram parses under mermaid 11.17.2

Every diagram stays within the intermediate node cap (12)

assertions: Every diagram parses under mermaid 11.17.2

No invented participants (inventory, cache, queue, worker, ...)
